title: Exponential Decay Curvature
idiom: Swiss modernist screenprint, one curve as slope and as sawtooth
hero_prompt: Swiss modernist two-colour screenprint in deep blue and orange on cream, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: across the left half one large smooth curve falling from high to low like a long hillside slope, and across the right half the very same curve shrunk and repeated many times side by side into a fast jagged sawtooth row, the big shape and its small copies sharing one line. A single orange dot where the large curve meets the small ones. Generous empty cream space.
icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour deep blue silhouette on a cream ground, no shading or gradients: a single thick curved line that falls steeply then flattens out, like a ski slope, ending in one bold orange dot. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
